items.title: Jerry Dodgion interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Well he said Bobby Plater had to take off, because he was writing a date for Lockjaw

ctx.x: Nice record. And how did that come about?

Well I knew almost everybody in the band because I’d gone to hear the band so much in those years. And one day Billy Mitchell called me and he said, “What are you doing Thursday?” I said, “I’m not doing anything, why?” He said, “Well would you like to make a recording date with Count Basie?” I said, “That’s why I’m alive.” I mean that’s the dream, I mean unbelievable, I thought that’s never going to happen. Well he said Bobby Plater had to take off, because he was writing a date for Lockjaw that was scheduled at…
Did they spend a lot of time in those sessions or was it pretty much a couple of takes?
